parent.title: Weekend in Heist around dinner at Bartholomeus

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Bartholomeus
siblings.summary: Eight character-rich hotels and B&Bs sorted by taxi minutes from Bartholomeus (Zeedijk 267, Heist), with the verdict up top.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Bartholomeus
siblings.summary: Pick Bruges for the canonical day, Zwin for nature, Sluis for Sunday shopping, Damme for cycling, De Haan for Belle Epoque — all reachable from Bartholomeus on the Zeedijk.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Bartholomeus
siblings.summary: Bruges (16 km) supplies essentially all the tech programming in the radius — EUSIPCO 2026 at the Concertgebouw is the headline; Howest's labs and the Building Bruges meetup carry the rest.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Bartholomeus, Heist
sources.claim: Bartholomeus carries 2 Michelin stars in the 2026 guide and is located at Zeedijk 267, Heist.

sources.title: Strandverblijf — Bartholomeus listing
sources.claim: Bartholomeus street address is Zeedijk-Heist 267, 8301 Heist with phone 050 51 75 76.

sources.title: Zeez — dining environment
sources.claim: Brasserie Bristol sits at Zeedijk-Heist 291, roughly 24 metres east of Bartholomeus along the same seafront promenade.

sources.title: Brasserie Bristol — verblijf
sources.claim: Brasserie Bristol at Zeedijk 291 partners with three on-promenade residences — Residentie Morrisson, Residentie Renée, and Residentie Bristol — sold as 'apartment comfort with hotel service'.

sources.title: Residentie Bristol — pricing
sources.claim: Residentie Bristol studios on Zeedijk 290 cost €310 for a winter weekend (2 nights) and €545 for a summer weekend; 2-room apartments run €1,120-€2,380 per week; parking €20/day.

sources.title: Residentie Renée
sources.claim: Residentie Renée at Zeedijk 290 offers sea-view studios for two persons, run by the same Residenties Delacourt operator as Bristol.

sources.title: A-Hotel — Residentie Mariposa
sources.claim: Residentie Mariposa apartment at Zeedijk 72 in Heist has 2 bedrooms, sea views over the Baai van Heist nature reserve, 9.3/10 guest rating, and rents from roughly $126/night.

sources.title: Booking.com — Studio Heist
sources.claim: Studio Heist apartment at Zeedijk 101, Heist scores 8.2/10 across 26 Booking.com reviews and is a 3-minute walk from Heist-Aan-Zee beach.

sources.title: Hotel.com.au — Archipel
sources.claim: Archipel beachfront apartment at Zeedijk-Heist 145 is rated 9.2/10 across 17 verified reviews and is 100 metres from Heist-Aan-Zee beach.

sources.title: Booking.com — Heist district
sources.claim: Heist sub-municipality of Knokke-Heist has 188 bookable accommodation options.

sources.title: MyBoutiqueHotel — B&B Aquavit
sources.claim: B&B Aquavit at Sint-Jorisstraat 7 in Heist is a 2-room design boutique B&B (24 m² Deluxe), adults-only, rated 9.6/10 across 22 reviews.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Studio Heyst
sources.claim: Studio Heyst on Kardinaal Mercierstraat sits about 100 metres from the beach, 5.0/5 on TripAdvisor (1 review), from roughly $157/night.

sources.title: B&B Morpheus
sources.claim: B&B Morpheus at Zeetrapper 16 has 2 rooms at €120/night and is a ~10-minute walk to the Heist seafront.

sources.title: BBBelgie — B&B B-eaufort
sources.claim: B&B B-eaufort at Kardinaal Mercierstraat 20 in central Heist is about 40 metres from the seafront but offers no on-site parking, WiFi or TV.

sources.title: Hotel Du Soleil
sources.claim: Hotel Du Soleil at Patriottenstraat 15 is a 3-star family-run hotel in Duinbergen, 50 metres from the sea.

sources.title: Booking.com — Hotel Britannia
sources.claim: Hotel Britannia in Het Zoute (Elizabetlaan 85) is roughly 1 hour 4 minutes walking from Heist — not a walking-distance option for Bartholomeus.

sources.title: Westtoer — Hotel St. Yves
sources.claim: Hotel St. Yves at Zeedijk-Heist 204 is a 3-star year-round seafront hotel with 8 rooms.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Hotel St. Yves
sources.claim: Hotel St. Yves scores 3.8/5 on TripAdvisor across only 6 reviews; cleanliness 3.6, service 3.0.

sources.title: 123Hotelboeken — Hotel St. Yves
sources.claim: Hotel St. Yves rooms start at roughly €100/night.
